c74object.name: evi_lockhart_simple
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Anti-aliased wavefolder device for shaping oscillators, simultaneous outputs up to four stages
c74object.description:
evi_lockhart_simple is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_lockhart_simple is also available in MSP as: evi.lockhart.simple~.
An analog model of the 'Lockhart Wavefolder' employing antiderivative anti-aliasing via Lambert-W functions. The waveshaper takes a simple audio signal and aggressively folds and clips it to produce new shapes and harmonics in the style of west coast synthesis. This 'simple' version has a fixed cascade for four simultaneous outputs of 4 stages, 3 stages, 2 stages or 1 stage. See evi.lockhart.cascade~ for a version with more options.

geninlet.name: osc
geninlet.digest: Input. Audio input to be wavefolded, typically a simple oscillator.
